verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a bulk-operation capability in AnythingLLM, such as multi-select actions or batch update or delete across many items. The Developer API for reading, writing and updating an instance is only a building block a developer could script loops against, and one community user querying 'a batch of regulatory PDFs' describes usage, not a documented bulk-operations feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
